heading: Refraction
text:
### Refraction [IRET.11.3]

Refraction is a property of the activation, the flag [LDET.5.3] describes
([IRET.11]). Each terminal node also keeps a **refraction table** of the token
identities that fired in the engine's current **cycle generation**. The
generation advances on every working-memory assert and retract and once per
pump; an entry of an earlier generation is stale and matches nothing, so the
table empties without being walked. The table catches an activation formed
again for an identity that already fired before any change to working memory,
and so before the match could have ended ([IRET.11.3.2]). The token identity
is the activation's tuple of participating fact ids; the 32-bit token hash is a
pre-filter, **not** the key. An entry matches only when both its token hash
**and** its fact-id tuple match (`refract_identity_match`, `terminal.c`).

idris.name: iret_11_3__fact_ids
idris.note: The identity of a match is its tuple of participating fact ids, as the clause requires; the 32-bit hash pre-filter is an unobservable optimisation and is not modelled.

idris.name: iret_11_3__ids
idris.note: A token's identity: `map fid tfacts`.

idris.name: iret_11_3__now_ids
idris.note: The identities of the current match tuples -- what a kept token is looked up against.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tok_ids
idris.note: The identities of a table's tokens.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_pairwise_short
idris.note: A distinct list whose members are pairwise equal has at most one.

idris.name: iret_7_7__consistent_distinct
idris.note: A consistent chain's activations carry distinct identities.

idris.name: Iret_11_3__ghost
idris.note: The refraction set of [IRET.11.3] beside the engine, kept through every operation and cleared where [IRET.11.3.2] clears it. A ghost: the engine never reads it, which is what the theorem shows it need not.

idris.name: Iret_11_3__refracted_fired
idris.note: Every identity in the set belongs to an activation carrying `fired`.

idris.name: Iret_11_3__refraction
idris.note: Every terminal's refraction set as one list of (ordinal, identity): the token identities that fired in the current cycle.

idris.name: Iret_11_3__sound
idris.note: THE SOUND GHOST: the view, and every identity in the set belonging to an activation carrying `fired` -- the set refuses nothing the flag does not.

idris.name: iret_11_3__elem_set_at
idris.note: A member of a list after an update at one position is an old member or the update of one.

idris.name: iret_11_3__engine_maybe
idris.note: The engine of a possible ghost; named so that no statement mentions a projection unapplied.

idris.name: iret_11_3__refraction_after_history
idris.note: THE REFRACTION THEOREM, closed at the top: after any history from a loaded network the ghost's engine is the history's engine, every refracted identity belongs to an activation carrying `fired`, and the selection of [IRET.11.4] 1a -- the first activation neither popped nor refracted -- is the model's first unfired activation. In the tick-free fragment the `fired` flag is the whole of refraction under each of the five statements of it, and Rete/FireLoop.idr's abstraction of refraction to that flag is grounded in the spec.

idris.name: iret_11_3__select_spec_agrees
idris.note: UNDER A SOUND GHOST the section's filtered selection is the model's: the set refuses nothing the flag does not.

idris.name: iret_11_3__same_tuple_same_tok
idris.note: With distinct tuples, two tokens of one table with one tuple are one token.

idris.name: iret_11_3__same_tuple_same_act
idris.note: With distinct identities, two activations of one terminal with one match are one activation.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tuples_of
idris.note: The tuples of a table, in table order; named so that no statement mentions a projection unapplied.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tuples_of_append
idris.note: The tuples of an appended table are the appended tuples.

idris.name: Iret_11_3__distinct
idris.note: No two entries with the same identity, the property [IRET.11.3] keys on.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_append
idris.note: Disjoint distinct lists append to a distinct list.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_concat
idris.note: A distinct list of distinct, pairwise disjoint lists concatenates to a distinct list.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_filter
idris.note: A sublist by filter of a distinct list is distinct.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_map_filter
idris.note: A sublist by filter, under a map, stays distinct.

idris.name: iret_11_3__distinct_map_inj
idris.note: An injective map keeps a list distinct.

idris.name: iret_11_3__elem_cons
idris.note: A member of a non-empty list is its head or a member of its tail. Once in NetworkRefraction and, as ldet_5_9__elem_cons, in NetworkOrderKeep; shared from here.

idris.name: iret_11_3__elem_tok_elem
idris.note: Membership of a token list, from the Bool to the proof.

idris.name: iret_11_3__elem_tok_false
idris.note: A Bool non-membership refutes membership.

idris.name: iret_11_3__elem_tok_true
idris.note: Membership of a token list, from the proof to the Bool.

idris.name: iret_11_3__not_elem_tok
idris.note: Refuted membership is Bool non-membership.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tok_eq
idris.note: Token identity: tuple equality is equality.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tok_eq_refl
idris.note: A tuple equals itself.

idris.name: iret_11_3__tok_neq
idris.note: Distinct tuples compare unequal.
